name: ring-td-q250
cmd: GDP_POOL=td GDP_POOL_Q=250 GDP_POOL_MS=4000 GDP_POOL_GROW=1 GDP_POOL_LIST=1 GDP_POOL_PICKS=research/protocols/engine/picks/ring_leader_election.txt GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log; s=$?; grep -E 'POOL|join (small instance|template|failed|enumerated|houdini|exists)' /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-30000; exit $s
